title: AM Publishing's second literary picnic took place in Berlin
preview: On August 23, we once again gathered book lovers in Berlin for a literary picnic. We got to know each other, chatted, grilled sausages, and, of course, exchanged books from our book trunk.
body:
It looks like AM Publishing is starting another tradition!
On August 23, we held our second literary picnic at Volkspark Friedrichshain. Despite the cloudy weather, we gathered again in a large group to get to know each other, talk about books and other topics, spend time together, and, of course, share stories.
At the start of the gathering, anyone who wanted to placed the books they’d brought into our now-traditional book suitcase, and at the end of the picnic, we held a book swap, where participants could choose a new story and take it home.
But books were far from the only reason we got together. We chatted, got to know each other, grilled sausages, shared our thoughts on what we’d read, and simply enjoyed spending our Sunday together.
For AM Publishing, it’s not just about publishing books—it’s also about creating a space for lively conversation around them. That’s why gatherings like these will become a regular part of our publishing house’s life. As long as the weather permits, we’ll meet in Berlin’s parks, and once the cold weather sets in, we plan to move our events indoors and try new formats: book swaps, group readings, book discussions, and other literary gatherings.
And once AM Publishing has its own space, we’ll definitely be gathering readers there.
Because books aren’t just the stories we read. Sometimes they give us a reason to meet people we might never have met otherwise.

title: AM Publishing's First Literary Picnic Was Held in Berlin
preview: On July 12, the first literary picnic organized by our publishing house took place in Berlin.
body:
The gathering brought together readers united by their love of books, face-to-face conversation, and meeting new people. Participants got to know one another, shared their favorite works, exchanged books, and spent a few cozy hours in the shade of the trees enjoying heartfelt conversations and light snacks. 

For AM Publishing, this picnic was the first step toward building a community of Russian-speaking readers in Berlin. We believe that books have the power to bring people together, and we hope that gatherings like this will become a cherished tradition.
